assessment: R-1 and D2 qualitative obligations correctly OPEN; V3-RC3 required for omitted nested contracts/Compare cost and mixed primary/staged repetition
answer_markdown:
6. R-1 dependency and the D2/checked-cost statements

The dependency is disclosed and correctly remains OPEN. Side_Sum is the new recursive expression function, with its numeric variant and no Post (D3:541-551). F20 treats the anticipated contracts-recursive/numeric-variant tags as an analogy with the existing Sum_Reference, not as a completed candidate probe (D3:276-292). The primary design adds a new declaration site to the R-1-class obligation; it cannot inherit acceptance from an earlier notice list or operator choice. O-NOTICE-R1 and P-R1 remain OPEN (D3:2039,2042).

A-GHOST-0 substitutes the existing Sum_Reference over non-recursively constructed ghost row arrays; it keeps no newly declared recursive Side_Sum (D3:573-584). Thus “notice-free” means no new D1 declaration site, not absence of the existing R-1 notices. It requires the full truncated-row/signed-difference equivalence proof, row-copy lifetimes and higher checked costs (D3:1517). Choosing it is lead-owned while it preserves the public contracts/domain and original checked code. Its “extra factor of about K” estimate is not yet source-complete and needs V3-RC3.

The related operator package remains a draft. R-1's own text preserves recurrences/domains/conjuncts/variants and leaves strict-warning resolution OPEN, with classification evidence P1–P3 proposed (W/work/claude-operator-decision-package-v1/DRAFT-v2.md:163-200). No classification or waiver is selected here. The warning-waiver option is incompatible with the fixed handoff, as is weakening a pinned reference or adding an assumed unfolding. Evidence-backed classification still needs independent review and complete body/caller/RTE/termination coverage; option labels cannot grant it. The apparent “no preserving rewrite” statement at :159-161 is not adopted as an impossibility theorem.

D3 correctly scopes D2 as the original plus D1-added checked contracts, Ghost, invariants, recursion, temporaries/copies, heap/stack/time and actual build/runtime identity (D3:1608-1624,2044-2048). It expressly forbids deleting original checked assertions merely because static proof closes (D3:1614-1618,1644-1645). OD-1 release mitigation does not close default checks; native failures do not acquire semantic refusal status. The static D2 inventory is separately under review and explicitly closes nothing (D2/INVENTORY.md:1-10). Its numerical cost formulas are not acceptance evidence for this review.

However F29 and §9.3 do not yet fulfill V2-RC6's complete nested-cost requirement:

- Prefix_Value_Worker is only a body cost. The public Prefix_Value Post recursively invokes Prefix_Value and Radix_Power, with further reference evaluations; Radix_Power has its own self-referential Post; Magnitude and Value call their subordinate ghost functions in both body and Post (C5/core/resource_quantities.ads:58-96; .adb:142-225). D3:352-355,1593,1596,1600 and A-GHOST-0's factor at :582 omit this source work. Retain these as known incomplete estimates until the full source recurrence is rebuilt; do not copy an unreviewed D2 formula into an accepted bound.
- Operand/Usage_Selected reaches Compare on Held usage rows. Compare's checked body includes Prefix_Padding, Is_Negative, assertions, per-column Magnitude invariants, recursive Prefix_Bounds and terminal assertions, beyond Compare's own Post (C5/core/resource_quantities.adb:350-399). D3:1598's Post-only model consequently omits work newly reached from D1's helper/invariant calls.
- Old_Work, Carry_In and Work_Value(Work)'Old are correctly acknowledged (D3:1080-1081,1602). Complete cost must still include their actual placement/copies/finalization, callee Pre/Post and lemma bodies at every call, and the additive Prefix token check. “No recursion” at D3:1133 must be limited to new B declarations, not its existing recursive checked references.
- Checked failure points need exact evidence. For IM-2's extent, the initial zero Work_Value can evaluate Power_Reference at exponent 804 before the original decimal accumulation reaches its value limit (D3:1063-1066,1163-1169; C5/core/resource_quantities.ads:47-56). Fresh JACKAL returned status=exact, parsed=805-1, exact=804 and parsed=256^804-2^6432, exact=0. This illustrates why a nominal zero or final-value bound does not avoid checked power failures. W-2 must record the actual checked location rather than presupposing a particular original arithmetic statement; generated/native location remains OPEN.

The repetition/failure map must cover both dependencies. Primary_And_Staged is an admitted dependency and Needs_Primary/Needs_Staged both hold for it (C5/core/worldline-evaluation_authority.ads:19-36). The mixed export independently invokes Read_Ready for primary and staged; each finalization-kind branch calls Decide. It can then invoke both Context_Joined branches, each reaching Final_Context_Matches/Decide (C5/core/evaluation_finalization_c.adb:273-278,386-388,429-447,474-482). Therefore “twice per mixed request” is not a complete bound (D3:334,1606). Fresh JACKAL returned status=exact, parsed=2+2, exact=4 for these potentially executed Decide calls. Using D3's source-supported up-to-four Integer_Matches occurrences per observed Seal (C5/core/evaluation_finalization.adb:129,270; .ads:362,384-398), a request with an integer node in each finalized bundle can incur up to sixteen such evaluations across those nodes: status=exact, parsed=4*(2+2), exact=16. This is a conditional source call count, not a measured native trace or a new guarantee.

There are still two kinds of mixed failure stage—readiness and context—but each has primary and staged locations. The design must add finalization.mixed.staged-ready-rejected and finalization.mixed.staged-context-rejected alongside the current primary labels (D3:1631-1632,1415-1416,1980; C5/core/evaluation_finalization_c.adb:446,481). Injection by “first then second Decide” is meaningful only after the selected dependency path is fixed; for both dependencies the second invocation can be staged readiness, not primary context. Required change V3-RC3 expands the source recurrence, repetition and stage mapping and synchronizes F29, §9, RL-1 cost wording, trace/status labels and decisions.json. O-GHOST, O-NOTICE-R1, O-BUILD-SELECTION, O-TRANSPORT-MAPPING and O-COST-MEASURE remain OPEN.
